proposed_frozen_design.variant_choice: PRIMARY = variant A (D1 z-score fade). proposed_frozen_design.signal: z(t) = (close_D1(t) − SMA200_D1(t)) / std60_D1(t), computed on NY17:00-boundary D1 closes reconstructed from 1h bars (weekend bars excluded, bars/week≈5 assert — wave-4/#18 QA convention). SMA200 = simple mean of prior 200 D1 closes (current bar excluded); std60 = sample std of prior 60 D1 closes (current bar excluded). No warmup shortcuts: first 200 D1 bars of each series emit no signals.
proposed_frozen_design.event: ONSET crossing only: |z(t)| >= 2.0 AND |z(t−1)| < 2.0. Direction = fade: z >= +2.0 -> SHORT, z <= −2.0 -> LONG. One event per excursion (no re-entry while |z| stays >= 2.0). 1 pair 1 open hypothetical position at a time (if an event fires while a prior hold is open, skip and count skips as diagnostic).
